intro: Volunteering and helping others, and how to express wishes for other people.
p.asociación.consejo: It ends in «-ción»: «a-so-thya-THYON». There are neighbours', music and charity associations.
p.voluntario.consejo: For a woman: «la voluntaria». It comes from «voluntad», wanting to do something.
p.colaborar.consejo: It is used with «con» or «en»: «colaboro con una asociación».
p.donar.consejo: You donate clothes, books, blood or money.
p.cuidar.consejo: With people it takes «a»: «cuido a mi abuela». Also: «cuidar las plantas».
p.repartir.consejo: It comes from «parte»: «repartir» is to give each one their share.
p.campaña.consejo: The ñ sounds like «ny»: «kam-PA-nya». A clean-up campaign collects rubbish.
p.soledad.consejo: It ends in «-dad», like «ciudad». It is feeling alone, even with people around.
p.solidario.consejo: It comes from «solidaridad». A «solidaria» person thinks of others.
p.apuntarse.consejo: It takes «se»: «me apunto». It is used with «a»: «me apunto a la campaña».
p.merece la pena.consejo: Here «pena» is not sadness: «merece la pena» is «vale la pena».
p.personas mayores.consejo: It is the kind way to talk about people of greater age.
b1.texto:
An **asociación** works with **voluntarios**: people who **colaboran** without being paid. They can **repartir** books, **cuidar** **personas mayores**, **hacer compañía** to someone who lives alone, or run a clean-up **campaña**. You can also **donar** clothes, books or money.

Helping fights **soledad**. A **solidaria** person thinks of others.

To invite someone: **¿Por qué no te apuntas?** **Merece la pena.**

To say what you wish for others: **quiero que**, **ojalá**, **es importante que** + subjunctive.
b2.f0.texto: What do you do on Saturday mornings?
b2.f1.texto: I help out as a volunteer in an association.
b2.f3.texto: We hand out books to children and to elderly people.
b2.f5.texto: That is why we keep them company on Saturdays.
b2.f6.texto: I only donate clothes from time to time.
b2.f7.texto: I hope you come with us one day.
b2.f8.texto: I think I will sign up next Saturday.
b4.texto:
To say what you want other people to do, use the subjunctive:

- **Quiero que** + subjunctive: **quiero que la gente sepa que no está sola**.
- **Ojalá** + subjunctive: **ojalá vengas un día**.
- **Es importante que** + subjunctive: **es importante que todos ayudemos**.

If the same person wants and does, use the infinitive: **quiero ayudar**, not «quiero que ayude» (for myself).

With people use the personal **a**: **cuido a mi abuela**, **ayudo a los vecinos**.
b4.e0.texto: I want elderly people not to feel alone.
b4.e1.texto: I hope you come and help one Saturday.
b4.e2.texto: It is important that we all help.
b5.f0.texto: On Saturday morning, the association's room smells of old paper and coffee.
b5.f1.texto: The boxes full of books wait on the floor like small mountains.
b5.f2.texto: Lucía opens a box and takes out a book with blue covers.
b5.f3.texto: A little girl looks at her with wide-open eyes.
b5.f4.texto: The book passes from hand to hand like a treasure.
b5.f5.texto: Next to the window, an old woman with white hair listens to a story.
b5.f6.texto: A young volunteer reads aloud calmly.
b5.f7.texto: The loneliness of the room melts like sugar in coffee.
b5.f8.texto: The laughter of the children rises to the ceiling and falls again.
b5.f9.texto: On saying goodbye, the old woman squeezes Lucía's hand with a smile.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! With people you use the personal «a».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Cuidar de» exists, but here the usual form is «cuidar a».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Con» is not used with this verb: «cuidar a».
b6.pregunta: You look after other people. What is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: A tourist travels to see places.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That's it! A volunteer helps because they want to.
b7.o2.refuerzo: A neighbour lives nearby; they do not have to help.
b7.pregunta: Someone helps others without being paid. They are…
b8.traduccion: It is important that we all help
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It is the same as «vale la pena».
b9.o1.refuerzo: Here «pena» is not sadness: it is effort.
b9.o2.refuerzo: The expression is not about money.
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Colaboran» is indicative. «Ojalá» asks for the subjunctive.
b10.pregunta: You express a wish. Which form is missing?
b12.o0.refuerzo: After «quiero que» comes the subjunctive, not «vienes».
b12.o2.refuerzo: After «que» you need a conjugated verb.
b12.pregunta: You want another person to come. What do you say?
p.colaboro.consejo: From «colaborar», to help out. The stress falls on «BO».
p.voluntaria.consejo: Feminine form of «voluntario». It is someone who helps for free, out of kindness.
p.hacéis.consejo: From «hacer», to do. It is the «vosotros» form used in Spain. The stress falls on the «é».
p.repartimos.consejo: From «repartir», to share out. The stress falls on «TI». Think of giving books to many people.
p.solas.consejo: Feminine plural of «solo», alone. It agrees with «personas», so it describes people living alone.
p.dono.consejo: From «donar», to donate. You give something away to help others.
p.apuntaré.consejo: From «apuntarse», to sign up. The «-é» ending is the future for «yo».
p.mayores.consejo: Plural of «mayor», older. With «los» in front it means the older people.
p.ayudemos.consejo: Subjunctive of «ayudar», to help. It comes after «que», as in «que todos ayudemos».
p.saca.consejo: From «sacar», to take out. The «c» before «a» sounds like «k».
p.tapas.consejo: Plural of «tapa», cover. It is the part that covers a box or a book.
p.abiertos.consejo: Plural of «abierto», open. It agrees with «ojos», which is masculine plural.
p.deshace.consejo: From «deshacer», to undo or dissolve. The «h» is silent, and «c» before «e» sounds like «th».
p.despedirse.consejo: From «despedir», to see off. The «-se» at the end shows you say goodbye yourself.
p.cuido.consejo: From «cuidar», to care for. «ui» is a diphthong, so it is one syllable.
p.compensa.consejo: From «compensar», to make up for. Here it means something is worth the effort. Stress on «PEN».
p.esfuerzo.consejo: In Spain the «z» sounds like «th». The stress falls on «FWER», as in «fuerzas».
p.colaboren.consejo: Subjunctive of «colaborar». It follows «que» and ends in «-en» for «ellos».
